machine: Commodore 64 PAL; Minimal64 and VICE; a plain PRG

brain.weight_layout: row o at weights + o * inputs, one signed byte per flag (two's complement)

hash_domains.behavioural: bytes 8..12, 16..17 and the weights, in slot order, SHA-256 (brain_hash)

retina.name: R0s
retina.table_layout: count, then ops[n], operands a[n], k-or-b[n] (the published triples stored as three arrays)
retina.reference_vector: refDx, refDy = senses 1 and 2 (the player's offset) in this build; h = sign(refDx), or the facing when zero

live.applied_action: sensePack+16 (the applied action of the frame being packed)
live.senses_layout: one byte per sense, the signed nibble in the low four bits (8..15 negative)

flash_colours.2: red: a lesson refused, the ring is full

live.seed_bytes: the parameter block: 32 seed bytes after the MURAL02 marker (tools/stamp_mural.py)

profiler.unit: CPU cycles, 16-bit; the live counts include interrupts, the pure ones (test hooks) do not

status_bits.3: last ack rejected: a chord hold in progress

lessons.entry_layout: bytes 0..9: the twenty sense nibbles, nibble i in byte i/2, the low nibble for even i; byte 10: the taught absolute action in the low nibble, the predicted raw output in the high nibble
lessons.slot_rule: the lesson with sequence s is at data + (s mod capacity) * 11; unread lessons are [read_seq, write_seq)
drain_procedure: sum every byte of those entries modulo 65536
write ack_seq = write_seq, ack_sum = the sum, then ack_request = 1
wait one frame; read status: bit 7 accepted (read_seq == write_seq), else bits 1..3 say why; re-read and retry on a stale range
lessons.replay: per lesson: unpack the senses, derive the flags with the retina table, the taught raw index (translate the absolute action with h of the block under the relative vocabulary), apply the rule; the result must equal the machine's weights and education count

test_hooks.note: research only: the hooks run the machine's own retina, forward pass and rule on supplied inputs; they change the slot's weights and education count when a lesson is taken

access.observation: everything above may be read at any time; read write_seq before and after a read of the weights to know no lesson intervened

research_control.ack_fields: ack_seq, ack_sum, ack_request: the drain handshake
research_control.capacity: may be lowered at boot before any lesson (research only)
research_control.slot: the whole slot may be written at boot to load a saved brain (marker, header, weights, mood); zeroing the weights and the education count and kind 0 is a reset
research_control.test_hooks: research only, absent from production semantics

access.cognition: the retina, the forward pass, the resolution, the rule and the lesson recording run only in the machine; the host never computes a prediction, chooses an action, derives a flag for him or writes a weight outside a load or reset

observe_per_lesson: the new ring entry (senses, taught, predicted)
the weights that changed (a diff of the two rows)
events: teach on/off (by the chord or the flag)
drain (ack accepted, the batch and its replay result)
derived: corrections (lessons whose predicted output differed from the taught index)
aliasing (the same senses taught two actions)

engine_commit_note: the commit whose generator built this PRG; the shipping commit that adds the PRG to deliverables/ is named in PHASE3.md
